title: Grape Nut Ice Cream
hookLine: Jamaican-inspired grape nut ice cream with 4 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to whip the cold heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract until well combined. Incorporate {m53346_1}, {m53346_2}, {m53346_3}, and {m53346_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure heavy cream first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold in the cereal and stir until evenly distributed throughout the mixture. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe container (such as a loaf pan). Lay plastic wrap on top of the ice cream to avoid freezer burn. Cover the container and freeze for at least 6 hours or until solid.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Once frozen, let the ice cream sit at room temperature for a few minutes to soften slightly before scooping and serving. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
